evals.prompt: can you make a jira ticket for this? support just pinged me — Jane Doe (jane.doe@acme-client.com) says she can't download her certificate PDF since yesterday's release, button just spins forever. happens in chrome, she tried twice. project is EDGE
evals.expected_output: A Bug draft for project EDGE with a symptom-style summary, the standard's Bug sections, the customer's name and email replaced with placeholders, missing details listed under open questions, and no ticket created in Jira.

evals.prompt: Turn this into a story: admins keep asking for a way to bulk export their learner list with completion status so they can report to their managers. Probably CSV is fine.
evals.expected_output: A Story draft in 'As a ..., I want ..., so that ...' form with at least two testable acceptance criteria, the project marked as not set and asked for, and no ticket created in Jira.
